summary: Driver window: when the driver exits it saves scrollback to <state>/tmux-driver.txt, kills the supervisor window, prints the line, sleeps TMUX_KEEP_HOURS (default 24) and kills h-<run>; `trap : INT` so a Ctrl-C never skips it; exact =targets. Suite PATH shim for the supervisor's claude. Three tmux checks; decision, architecture §3/§4/§10, README. 296 → 299.
verified_how: lib/check.sh: 299/299 (check: green in 519 s); the three new tmux checks watched failing first (0/3), the Ctrl-C part watched failing without the trap; bash -n on bin/harness, tests/run.sh, lib/config.sh. An Opus review's four findings fixed (Ctrl-C, leading-zero hours, supervisor-window race, vacuous -s check).

dead_ends.tried: asserting the printed line with plain capture-pane -p
dead_ends.why: the pane wraps at 80 columns; -J joins it (also used for tmux-driver.txt)
under a C locale it makes the em-dash $'…', bash-only; now only the path is %q'd

discoveries.text: tests/run.sh now exports PATH=$T/bin:$PATH at the top with $T/bin/claude wrapping stub-claude.sh; tmux runs end through --until-epoch in the past and are waited on with tended <state> / tgone <session> (defined in the L3-03 block, reusable by L3-04's checks). Each tmux run's tmux-driver.txt holds the driver's 'deadline reached' line.

The window's message promises 'or sooner on harness gc', which holds only once L3-04's reaper lands. bin/harness's tmux new-window targets now use =<s>:, and the supervisor prompt is rendered before new-session.
The known flake 'queue holds an entry whose project has a live run' failed once more while two tmux iteration runs loaded the box; the clean rerun passed.

proposed_changes: L3-03 step 1 names `tmux capture-pane -p -S -`: built as `-pJ` (joins wrapped lines) plus `trap : INT` on the window shell, both from the review; recorded in decisions/2026-10-25-tmux-driver-window
